run_state_allorder_teacher: run the StateAllorderChunkTeacher to predict all player orders using state-only input data
run_message_history_state_teacher: run the MessageHistoryStateAllOrderChunkTeacher to predict orders using message history and state input
run_order_history_teacher: run the OrderHistorySinceLastMovementPhaseShortStateAllOrderChunkTeacher to predict orders using order history and state
review_base_allorder_teacher: review the _BaseAllOrderTeacher class and its allorders_mark_all_holds and filter_all_holds CLI arguments
run_press_variant_teachers: run the MessageHistoryShortStateAllOrderChunkTeacher or MessageHistoryPrefixStateOrderChunkTeacher for press variant order prediction
